title: Ukrainian Potato Galette
description: A rich, velvety, and citrusy Ukrainian dish made with potato starch, ideal for hangover recovery. Its brine-dry texture and vegan-friendly ingredients make it a unique breakfast option.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together potato starch, non-dairy milk, vegan butter, lemon juice, dill, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9-inch pie dish.
Drizzle olive oil over the top and sprinkle with baking powder.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional chopped dill, if desired.
Serve warm, topped with your favorite hangover-curing condiments, if needed.
Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days in the refrigerator or freeze for up to 2 months.
